text: Should the legacy direct-UDP combat-profile evidence path be retired? Routed evidence now covers normal play. Retiring it closes BRL-rhw3 by deletion and makes BRL-5fk5 (preset 3 lob checkpoint) obsolete. Keeping it means moving that code behind brawler-client/automation and then fixing 5fk5.
suggestions: Retire it (delete the legacy path; cancel BRL-5fk5)
Keep it (move behind automation, then fix BRL-5fk5)
